name: Story reward: Dino World conclusion
comment: Script 1756 (XX_Story Quest Reward ... Conclusion 528935). A world's last story step: a Member Super Chest and the bag of the minifigure its last story dungeon, 6300 Gauntlet (the T-Rex), shows as the reward in its teleport window (RDB 1000644, as pocket adventures' world `minifigure`) (the user's rule 2026-10-29: 'a Member Super Chest + the minifigure associated with that dungeon's reward'; which dungeon concludes the world and that the minifigure comes as a bag are guesses, docs/TUNABLES.md).
